conditions: Nonzero test charge at rest in the chosen inertial frame; external electromagnetic force only, excluding self-force and other forces. Assume negligible perturbation of the source distribution (ideal test-charge limit).

symbols.\\mathbf F: External electric force on test charge

spoken_aliases: vector e equals vector f divided by q
electric field vector equals the external electric force vector on the test charge divided by its signed charge

evidence: The external electric force on a test charge at rest obeys F=qE. Divide the vector equation by the nonzero signed charge. A sufficiently small test charge approximates the unperturbed external field; its self-field is excluded.
Reference checked 2026-11-27: https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-2/pages/5-key-equations. Proposed maintainer approval, not independent human certification.
